answer: When an autonomous agent network tracks microclimates from a limestone karst and coastal island to a citrus grove, Sybil resistance can rely on proof of burn. To join, an agent must provably destroy on-chain tokens, imposing a verifiable, non-recoverable loss of scarce capital per identity. However, severe market devaluation of the burned token reduces the real-world attack cost, allowing adversaries to cheaply flood the network.
